paite: Zawng thuak di ngau in thuak
explainer: Thil hih khelh ziaka athuaktu di diktak in thuak khalou a, midang khat in thuak daih.

Numeite ava lutna te uh (pasal ava neihnate uh) dandan a kikhek thei. Baalchi kibang chiatchiat le leihoih a baal a kisuan chiang in baal hoih se a, lei hoihlouhna ah bel baal hoih theilou. Huchimah bang in, numeite bang le innsung hoih a pasal a neih khak ualeh hoih mai uh chihna dan ahi.
Na utlouh/zohlouh ding thil bangmah pan ken. I zohlouh ding banghiam a bul pat selouh ding chih genna a kizang tangpi ahi.
Lawmta kivual chiat lak a le ana tei deuh tuam om, vaihawm thei di khop a mahni kivawk khe thei om.

paite: Duh se lua akta kiloh khuh
explainer: Duham luatna lam a nekdi/muhdi tanloh.
Mahni omna mun/inn a hangsan kisa a hang gamgam. Mun a ngam a gal a ngamlou.
Nekdi nei mengmeng lou, nekdi muhkhak sunsun chianga nek-a-ne maimah. Duh-am nek.
